# Function Objective: Read a price from text
# Input parameters : str_price_text (string) price written as text
# Function description: Convert the text to a number rounded to two decimals; text that is not a number gives zero
# Return Value : float price
# Created By : Programmer A
# Create Date: 2026-09-28
# Revised By:
# Revised Date:
def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    fPrice = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        fPrice = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        fPrice = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        fPrice = round(fPrice, 2)
    return fPrice
